title: Enrichment analysis with perturbation signatures
text: GSE41291 microarray time course HSG cell line, untreated treated IFN-alpha IFN-gamma, triplicate. use 4-hour samples make two DE comparisons: IFN-alpha vs untreated IFN-gamma vs untreated.
code: gse <- getGEO("GSE41291", AnnotGPL = TRUE)[[1]] gse$condition <- sub("^HSG (\\S+) .*$", "\\1", gse$title) gse$time <- sub("^HSG \\S+ (\\S+) rep\\d+$", "\\1", gse$title)  gse4hr <- gse[, gse$time == "4hr"] table(gse4hr$condition) #>  #>  IFNalpha  IFNgamma untreated  #>         3         3         3

title: Enrichment analysis with perturbation signatures
text: fgsea needs one statistic per gene. use limma t-statistic, drop probes without unique gene symbol keep highly expressed probe gene:
code: condition <- factor(gse4hr$condition, levels = c("untreated", "IFNalpha", "IFNgamma")) design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + condition) colnames(design) <- levels(condition)  contrasts <- makeContrasts(IFNalpha = IFNalpha - untreated,                            IFNgamma = IFNgamma - untreated,                            levels = design) fit <- lmFit(gse4hr, design) fit <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrasts)) getRanks <- function(fit, contrast) {     de <- as.data.table(topTable(fit, coef = contrast, number = Inf))     de <- de[!is.na(Gene.symbol) & Gene.symbol != "" &                  !grepl("///", Gene.symbol, fixed = TRUE)]     de <- de[order(-AveExpr)][!duplicated(Gene.symbol)]     setNames(de$t, de$Gene.symbol) }  ranks <- list(IFNalpha = getRanks(fit, "IFNalpha"),               IFNgamma = getRanks(fit, "IFNgamma")) lengths(ranks) #> IFNalpha IFNgamma  #>    19593    19593

title: Enrichment analysis with perturbation signatures
text: getGeneSets() takes topK genes largest weights signature, genes go perturbation. Use direction = "" genes go , direction = "" (_UP _DN sets). Passing genes DE profile universe picks top genes among fgsea can use, every gene set keeps topK genes. comparisons come arrays, share one gene universe. positive NES means DE profile goes way perturbation; negative NES means goes opposite way.
code: geneSets <- getGeneSets(signatures, topK = 100, universe = names(ranks$IFNalpha)) length(geneSets) #> [1] 165

title: Enrichment analysis with perturbation signatures
code: set.seed(42) fgseaRes <- lapply(ranks, function(stats) {     fgsea(pathways = geneSets, stats = stats) }) plotTopSignatures <- function(fgseaRes, stats) {     topUp <- fgseaRes[ES > 0][head(order(pval), n = 10), pathway]     topDown <- fgseaRes[ES < 0][head(order(pval), n = 10), pathway]     plotGseaTable(geneSets[c(topUp, rev(topDown))], stats, fgseaRes, gseaParam = 0.5) }

title: Convert signatures to gene sets — getGeneSets
code: getGeneSets(   signatures,   topK = 200,   direction = c("up", "both", "down"),   universe = rownames(signatures) )

title: Convert signatures to gene sets — getGeneSets
text: signatures Signature weight matrix (genes x signatures), returned loadSignatures(). topK Number genes per gene set. direction "" (top weights) "" (bottom weights) make one set per signature, named signature; "" makes two sets per signature, named _UP _DN suffixes. universe Genes choose , example names statistic vector gene sets tested . Restricting keeps every gene set topK genes fgsea drops genes missing statistic.

title: Load perturbation signatures — loadSignatures
text: Reads perturbation signatures (per-gene logistic regression coefficients) human mouse. CSV file downloaded https://alserglab.wustl.edu/files/pertsig/ first call read cache afterwards.

title: Load perturbation signatures — loadSignatures
code: loadSignatures(   species = c("hsa", "mmu"),   geneId = c("symbol", "entrez"),   cacheDir = tools::R_user_dir("pertsig", which = "cache"),   force = FALSE )

title: Load perturbation signatures — loadSignatures
text: species Species code: "hsa" (human) "mmu" (mouse). geneId Gene identifiers use row names: "symbol" "entrez". identifier occurs , first row kept. cacheDir Directory downloaded files cached. force TRUE, download file even cached.

title: Load perturbation signatures — loadSignatures
text: numeric matrix signature weights genes rows signatures columns. Signatures merge several perturbations named first one ("IFNG + STAT1" becomes "IFNG").

title: pertsig: Perturbation Signatures Collection — pertsig-package
text: Loads pre-computed perturbation signatures (gene-level weights logistic regression models) turns gene sets top-weighted genes, ready enrichment analysis 'fgsea'.
